## Checklist

For a notice:

- [ ] It follows [the notice format](https://github.com/breakwise/breakwise/blob/main/docs/notice-format.md) and covers one change.
- [ ] Every reference is an official source of the package.
- [ ] It has the next free ID and `status: draft`.
- [ ] Its examples are as small as possible and run offline.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_notices.py` passes.

For code:

- [ ] Every change in behavior has a test, and coverage stays at 100%.
- [ ] The docs describe the change.
